name: gum
description: A tool for glamorous shell scripts 🎀
readme: A tool for glamorous shell scripts. Leverage the power of Bubbles and Lip Gloss in your scripts and aliases without writing any Go code! Gum provides highly configurable, ready-to-use utilities to help you write useful shell scripts and dotfile aliases with just a few lines of code. Let's build a simple script to help you write Conventional Commits for your dotfiles.
